text:
lina: Starting a mini-burnin canary for model v2.1-quant4 on the chat route. Planning 1% traffic to begin, slice=longform and shortprompt mixed. kicking off in ~15m.

sam: sg. quick checklist — what gating signals do we want active for auto-fallback? p95 latency, token cost, and quality signals (concordance + hallucination). also cold-start kv-warmup metric.

rachel: proposed thresholds: p95_latency <= baseline * 1.20, p99_latency <= baseline * 1.40 (short window), token_cost delta <= +10%, hallucination_rate delta <= +1.0% absolute, concordance >= 97% of baseline.

lina: sample size? want to avoid noisy early trips.

sam: require either 10k requests across cohort or 50k tokens, and at least 30 minutes of steady observations before any auto-rollback can fire. if metric fails persistently for 3 consecutive 10m buckets, then trigger.

rachel: add a soft-fail tier: if a single metric (latency or cost) breaches but quality is fine, throttle ramp (hold at 1% and alert) instead of hard rollback. hard rollback requires quality breach OR two-tier breach (e.g., latency + hallucination).

lina: including KV cache warmup check: cold-start tail rate (requests with kv_miss and >200ms extra) must be <2x baseline; otherwise fail on longdoc slices.

sam: agree. also add an entropy-based sanity: token-level perplexity spike > 50% on the eval sample -> immediate roll back.

kevin: can we express this as the auto-fallback config to push into the rollout system? here's a compact snippet I used last week — can we reuse and tweak?

rachel: paste snippet pls so we can validate with infra.

kevin: ```yaml
canary:
  id: cny-mini-burnin-20260323
  initial_weight: 0.01
  slices: [longform, shortprompt]
  min_sample_count: 10000
  min_tokens: 50000
  steady_window: 30m
  buckets: 10m
  metrics:
    - name: p95_latency
      comparator: ratio
      threshold: 1.20
      action: hold
    - name: p99_latency
      comparator: ratio
      threshold: 1.40
      action: hold
    - name: token_cost
      comparator: delta_percent
      threshold: 10
      action: hold
    - name: hallucination_rate
      comparator: delta_absolute
      threshold: 1.0
      action: rollback
    - name: concordance
      comparator: ratio
      threshold: 0.97
      action: rollback
    - name: kv_cold_tail_rate
      comparator: ratio
      threshold: 2.0
      action: rollback
  rollback_policy:
    consecutive_buckets: 3
    require_min_samples: true
```

lina: this looks good. infra: can we wire p95/p99 from the edge tracer and hallucination/concordance from the eval pipeline?

rachel: yes — infra already exposes p95/p99 per route per model via trace-aggregator. eval pipeline can emit concordance/hallucination as streamed metrics for shadow slices. we'll tag canary with shadow compare id so we get live eval metrics.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: id=cny-mini-burnin-20260323, start=7689012345, weight=1%, slices=longform,shortprompt. Auto-fallback=ENABLED.

sam: ok run playbook: monitor first 2 hours manually, if everything stable and min_samples satisfied we can bump to 5% for 6h, then 10% pending stability. if any rollback triggers, we'll pull traffic to baseline and create a postmortem.

lina: noted. I'll attach the smoke eval set and the seed prompts to the canary job now. pulling the ramp plan into the runbook. :eyes:

kevin: one more ask — add an alert to #eng-oncall where any canary action (hold/rollback) posts a short summary with top failing metrics and sample IDs for quick triage.

rachel: done, the webhook is attached.

lina: thanks team. starting in 10. will update thread with first 30m snapshot.

sam: :thumbsup: good luck!

kevin: will watch the dashboard and call if we see weird dispersion across slices.

lina: update 10m: no rollbacks yet, p95 +8%, p99 +12%, hallucination delta 0.2%, concordance 99.1%. keeping at 1%. next update in 20m.
